meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 装上后,当你提供 cmem.ai 连接凭据,Claude 会把它写进本插件的配置文件,让记忆的读取和保存能用;若电脑也装了本地版 claude-mem,会把同样的值同步过去,并告诉你怎么让连接长期有效。
howto.when: 当你说“set up claude-mem”、“pair claude-mem”等配对请求,或要求把 cmem.ai 连接信息(sync token、用户 ID 等)配进插件时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 claude-mem 和 Cowork 配对起来。
say.note: 会先向你要这三项连接信息,再写进插件设置。

say.text: 这是我 cmem.ai Connect 的连接信息,请帮我配好。
say.note: 会从这段信息里抽出三样,写入插件配置。

say.text: 我只有 sync token,能先配上吗?
say.note: 缺用户 ID 和 SyncHub URL 也能先配上。

howto.what_en: Claude saves your cmem.ai credentials to the plugin's config so memory hooks can capture and inject context. If a local claude-mem exists, it writes the same values there and explains how to make pairing permanent.
howto.when_en: When you ask to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", etc., or paste cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin.

say_en.note: Claude asks for your cmem.ai Connect values and saves them to config.

say_en.text: Here are my cmem.ai Connect values — please set them up.
say_en.note: Extracts token, user id, and SyncHub URL into config.

say_en.text: I only have a sync token. Can you pair it anyway?
say_en.note: Token alone is enough; user id and URL are optional.
